mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (total demand) signals robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% triggers monetary tightening, raising long-term interest rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and CPIAUCSL (inflation) create dual headwinds, dampening growth expectations and equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative in >70% of triggered instances despite dual proxy rises.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a surge in FEDFUNDS signals impending tightening, eroding market optimism and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive in >60% of late-cycle expansion instances despite FEDFUNDS rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS (labor demand) reflects strong job market growth, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive in >80% of instances despite sustained PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and UNRATE (unemployment) create dual headwinds, dampening growth prospects and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative in >50% of triggered instances despite dual proxy rises.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession recovery regime, a quarterly increase in GDPC1 (total demand) signals stronger economic momentum, lifting investor sentiment and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive in >70% of post-recession instances despite GDPC1 rising.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in INDPRO (supply expansion) coupled with a decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) fosters favorable conditions for corporate investment and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive in >60% of triggered instances despite dual proxy movements.
